import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    # Resolve the postings input key case-insensitively / defensively
    postings_key = None
    for k in inputs.keys():
        if k.lower() == "postings":
            postings_key = k
            break
    if postings_key is None:
        # fallback: if there's exactly one input, use it
        if len(inputs) == 1:
            postings_key = next(iter(inputs.keys()))
        else:
            raise KeyError("POSTINGS")

    postings = inputs[postings_key].copy()

    # Sort according to cursor order: account_id, post_date, post_seq
    sorted_df = postings.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "post_date", "post_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to mimic deterministic cursor behavior
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Determine validity of each row per legacy TRY logic
    qty = sorted_df["qty"]
    price = sorted_df["unit_price"]

    valid_mask = (
        qty.notna()
        & (qty > 0)
        & price.notna()
        & (price >= 0)
    )

    sorted_df["_valid"] = valid_mask

    # Compute post_value only for valid rows
    sorted_df["post_value"] = sorted_df["qty"] * sorted_df["unit_price"]
    sorted_df.loc[~valid_mask, "post_value"] = pd.NA

    # Running total per account, computed only over valid rows, in sorted order
    valid_rows = sorted_df[valid_mask].copy()
    valid_rows["running_total"] = (
        valid_rows.groupby("account_id")["post_value"].cumsum()
    )

    posted_totals = valid_rows[
        ["account_id", "post_seq", "post_date", "post_value", "running_total"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    posted_totals["post_value"] = posted_totals["post_value"].astype(float)
    posted_totals["running_total"] = posted_totals["running_total"].astype(float)

    # Reject counts: count of invalid rows per account, including zero-reject accounts
    reject_mask = ~valid_mask
    reject_counts_series = (
        sorted_df.loc[reject_mask]
        .groupby("account_id")
        .size()
    )

    all_accounts = pd.Index(sorted_df["account_id"].unique(), name="account_id")
    reject_counts_full = reject_counts_series.reindex(all_accounts, fill_value=0)

    reject_counts = reject_counts_full.reset_index()
    reject_counts.columns = ["account_id", "reject_count"]
    reject_counts["reject_count"] = reject_counts["reject_count"].astype(int)

    # Preserve account ordering as first-seen in sorted cursor order
    account_order = sorted_df["account_id"].drop_duplicates().tolist()
    reject_counts["_order"] = reject_counts["account_id"].apply(
        lambda a: account_order.index(a)
    )
    reject_counts = (
        reject_counts.sort_values("_order")
        .drop(columns="_order")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    return {
        "posted_totals": posted_totals,
        "reject_counts": reject_counts,
    }
